The '''"Double-Blind" Jammer System''' was a model of [[Sensor jammer/Legends|sensor jammer]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. The system was installed on [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] such as [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|''FireStar''-class Orbital Defense Stations]].<ref name="HS" />
